_schema: WI-074 skip-conditions registry — single source of truth for which skills document skip/NA conditions in their self-verify sections. route-workflow/SKILL.md self-verify row #2 reads from this registry to enforce skip-justification logging.

design-ui:no-visual-surface.applies_when: No browser-visible UI surface exists for the work item.
design-ui:no-visual-surface.required_evidence: change_type=docs, framework lane, or explicit no-visual-surface signal

track-visuals:no-browser-visible-change.applies_when: The graph has no browser-visible UI, CSS, layout, asset, or rendered-state change.

test-journeys:no-runtime-behavior-change.applies_when: The graph has no user/admin-facing runtime behavior path.

write-e2e:no-runtime-behavior-change.applies_when: E2E coverage is not applicable because no runtime behavior path changed.

audit-implementation:no-technical-risk.applies_when: No backend, external integration, auth, data model, concurrency, or high-blast-radius surface exists.
audit-implementation:no-technical-risk.required_evidence: changed-file and risk-flag scan showing no technical-risk surface

review-plan:trivial-or-prior-reviewed.applies_when: The changeset is trivial or an equivalent adversarial plan review already exists.
review-plan:trivial-or-prior-reviewed.required_evidence: trivial line/file count or path to prior review artifact

base44-environment:not-base44-deploy.applies_when: No Base44 platform or deploy-affecting obligation is present.

audit-session-execution:not-retroactive.applies_when: The closeout is not retroactive, graph-mismatch, missing-route-log, or user-challenged.
audit-session-execution:not-retroactive.required_evidence: route log and closeout challenge scan

design-ui.skip_when: Feature has no visual/UI surface (backend-only, config-only, or CLI-only work).
signals: no HTML or JSX markup change
no visual component added or modified
lane is framework or refactor without UI implication
design-ui.self_verify_row: design-ui/SKILL.md § Self-Verify — skip row documented inline in the skill's instructions

design-ux.skip_when: Feature has no UX surface (pure enabler, backend-only, internal tooling with no flow or state machine).
signals: no new screen or interaction pattern
design-ux.self_verify_row: design-ux/SKILL.md § Self-Verify — skip clause for enabler/backend features

execute-changeset.skip_when: TDD step is not applicable (e.g., doc-only change, configuration-only, test itself is the deliverable).
execute-changeset.self_verify_row: execute-changeset/SKILL.md § Self-Verify row for TDD applicability

track-visuals.skip_when: No UI surface present — track-visuals cannot capture what doesn't render.
track-visuals.self_verify_row: track-visuals/SKILL.md § Self-Verify row 7 (skip-justified if no visual surface)

test-journeys.skip_when: Viewport coverage can be skipped when feature has no visual surface; record in SUMMARY.md.
test-journeys.justification_format: SUMMARY.md entry naming the skipped scenarios + reason, plus lane-tasks JSON skip_reason field
test-journeys.self_verify_row: test-journeys/SKILL.md line 92 and skip_reason pattern in step templates

write-e2e.skip_when: E2E not applicable — backend-only change, unit-test-sufficient, or lane-tasks JSON explicitly marks task skippable.
signals: lane-tasks.json task marked skippable with reason
write-e2e.justification_format: lane-tasks-<WI>.json task marked completed with skip reason field; mirror that status to TaskList

benchmark-landing.skip_when: Dimension 9 (design delta vs baseline) is skipped on greenfield first-pass when no predecessor exists; weight redistributed.
benchmark-landing.justification_format: benchmark YAML marks dimension 9 as skipped with weight-redistribution note
benchmark-landing.self_verify_row: benchmark-landing/SKILL.md § Iteration case F-015 — dimension 9 skip + weight redistribution

analyze-domain.skip_when: User can skip domain research explicitly, or lane-tasks task marked skippable with reason.
analyze-domain.justification_format: lane-tasks-<WI>.json skip_reason, plus domain-profile.md note if domain remains unresolved

blend-external.skip_when: External source's approach is adequate in svc form already (SKIP verdict in blend-dimension table).
blend-external.justification_format: blend-analysis.md verdict column = SKIP with 1-2 sentence rationale

audit-ac.skip_when: AC marked with ⛔ means skip forever in E2E planning (distinct from 🔲 pending).
audit-ac.justification_format: AC row emoji ⛔ with rationale in spec

sync-work-items.skip_when: Host mirroring can be skipped when the consistency check fails — file state is the durable record.
sync-work-items.justification_format: lane-tasks JSON skip_reason field + log to pipeline-decisions.jsonl

validate-feature.skip_when: Business questions can be skipped if the escape-hatch context scan reveals the feature is already validated.
validate-feature.justification_format: Ship Brief notes the skip reason; escape-hatch criteria documented inline
validate-feature.self_verify_row: validate-feature/SKILL.md § Step 0 escape hatch for business questions

review-plan.skip_when: Changeset is trivial (≤2 files, ≤50 lines) OR a post-plan adversarial review has already been performed and logged. NEVER skip on changesets >2 files or >50 lines without a prior review-log.yaml.
signals: review-log.yaml exists from prior review of this plan
framework-internal fix with existing review-plan precedent
review-plan.justification_format: lane-tasks-<WI>.json skip_reason field must cite either 'trivial changeset (N files, M lines)' or 'post-plan review exists at <path>'. Pipeline-decisions.jsonl entry: {"skill":"review-plan","decision":"skipped","reason":"<trivial|reviewed>"}
review-plan.self_verify_row: review-plan/SKILL.md § Self-Verify — skip row with changeset-size gate

audit-implementation.skip_when: Feature has no data model, no external integration, no concurrency, and no security-sensitive path (auth, payments, secrets). Pure UI/docs/config changes with no behavioral impact.
signals: no API calls to external services
no auth middleware, no payment flow, no secret handling
audit-implementation.justification_format: lane-tasks-<WI>.json task marked completed with skip_reason field; pipeline-decisions.jsonl entry: {"skill":"audit-implementation","decision":"skipped","reason":"<why no audit surface>"}
audit-implementation.self_verify_row: audit-implementation/SKILL.md § When To Run — skip rules for low-risk changes

verify-promotion.skip_when: Skipping a verification tier to a higher tier requires explicit justification (structural constraint or aesthetic claim).
signals: V3 handoff when V2 is structurally impossible
verify-promotion.justification_format: verification report carries V3 handoff justification block naming the structural or subjective constraint
verify-promotion.self_verify_row: verify-promotion/SKILL.md § V3 handoff justification + VERIFIED-USER status rule

activation_conditions._schema: WI-512 §2 stage-activation registry — quote-derived from proposals/2026-08-02-one-lane-framework.md §2 'Conditions, deliberately mechanical' table. Consumed by scripts/stage-activation.mjs via --conditions. Essential stages (plan, review-plan, implement, review-exec, spec-sync, index-restamp) may never appear as keys here — the script refuses (exit 2) if they do.

perf.condition: diff touches a query path, a loop over rows, or an index

translations.condition: diff adds or changes a user-visible string

device-proof.condition: diff touches src/**, android/**, ios/** or a native permission

visuals.condition: diff touches a rendered component or a design token

pricing.condition: diff touches plans.generated.js, a fee path, or a priced surface

marketing.condition: diff touches a capability the marketing context claims
